findings.note: The 'application' definition requires the concept to be known and then aimed at the wrong quantity, interval, body or frame. This entry says in its own words that the student worked 'without using v squared equals u squared minus two a s at all' and simply read the stated velocity fraction as the distance ratio - a wrong belief that distance falls in the same proportion as speed, which is 'concept'. I have capped this at weak because it is a concept-versus-application boundary, and a route is required either way, so the menu is unaffected.
